verses.geez: ወአዘዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዓንበሬ፡ ዓቢየ፡ የሐቶ፡ ለዮናስ፡ ወነበረ፡ ዮናስ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ ዐንበሪ፡ ሠሉሰ፡ ዕለተ፡ ወሠሉሰ፡ ሌሊተ።
verses.translation: Now the Lord had commanded a great whale to swallow up Jonas: and Jonas was in the belly of the whale three days and three nights.

translations.lxx: Now the Lord had commanded a great whale to swallow up Jonas: and Jonas was in the belly of the whale three days and three nights.
translations.kjv: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly,
translations.ron: Şi Dumnezeu a dat poruncă unui peşte mare să înghită pe Iona. Şi a stat Iona în pântecele peştelui trei zile şi trei nopţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέταξε Κύριος κήτει μεγάλῳ καταπιεῖν τὸν Ἰωνᾶν· καὶ ἦν Ἰωνᾶς ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ τοῦ κήτους τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας.

verses.geez: ወጸለየ፡ ዮናስ፡ በውስተ፡ ከርሰ፡ ዐንበሪ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላኩ።
verses.translation: And Jonas prayed to the Lord his God out of the belly of the whale,

translations.lxx: And Jonas prayed to the Lord his God out of the belly of the whale,
translations.kjv: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a rugat Iona din pântecele peştelui către Domnul Dumnezeul lui, zicând:
translations.grk: Καὶ προσηύξατο Ἰωνᾶς πρὸς Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας τοῦ κήτους,

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ አውየውኩ፡ በምንዳቤየ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላኪየ፡ ወሰምዐኒ፡ በውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ ለሲኦል፡ ጽራኀየ፡ ወሰምዐኒ፡ ቃልየ።
verses.translation: and said, I cried in my affliction to the Lord my God, and he hearkened to me, even to my cry out of the belly of hell: thou heardest my voice.

translations.lxx: and said, I cried in my affliction to the Lord my God, and he hearkened to me, even to my cry out of the belly of hell: thou heardest my voice.
translations.kjv: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
translations.ron: "Strigat-am către Domnul în strâmtorarea mea, şi El m-a auzit; din pântecele locuinţei morţilor către El am strigat, şi El a luat aminte la glasul meu!
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν, Ἐβόησα ἐν θλίψει μου πρὸς Κύριον τὸν Θεόν μου, καὶ εἰσήκουσέ μου, ἐκ κοιλίας ᾅδου κραυγῆς μου, ἤκουσας φωνῆς μου, ἀπέῤῥιψάς με εἰς βάθη καρδίας θαλάσσης,

verses.geez: ወወሮከኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ቀላየ፡ ባሕር፡ ወዐጉኒ፡ አፍላግ፡ ወመጽአ፡ ኲሎ፡ ማዕበልከ፡ ወሞገድከ፡ እንተ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ኀለፈ።
verses.translation: Thou didst cast me into the depths of the heart of the sea, and the floods compassed me: all thy billows and thy waves have passed upon me.

translations.lxx: Thou didst cast me into the depths of the heart of the sea, and the floods compassed me: all thy billows and thy waves have passed upon me.
translations.kjv: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
translations.ron: Tu m-ai aruncat în adânc, în sânul mării şi undele m-au înconjurat; toate talazurile şi valurile Tale au trecut peste mine.
translations.grk: καὶ ποταμοί ἐκύκλωσάν με, πάντες οἱ μετεωρισμοί σου καὶ τὰ κύματά σου ἐπʼ ἐμὲ διῆλθον.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ እቤ፡ ገደፍከኒኑ፡ እንጋ፡ እምቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ እደግምኑ፡ ርእየ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስከ።
verses.translation: And I said, I am cast out of thy presence: shall I indeed look again toward thy holy temple?

translations.lxx: And I said, I am cast out of thy presence: shall I indeed look again toward thy holy temple?
translations.kjv: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
translations.ron: Şi gândeam: Aruncat sunt dinaintea ochilor Tăi! Dar voi vedea din nou templul cel sfânt al Tău!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα, ἀπῶσμαι ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν σου· ἆρα προσθήσω τοῦ ἐπιβλέψαι με πρὸς ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου;

verses.geez: ውኀዘ፡ ማይ፡ እስከ፡ ነፍስየ፡ ወዐገተኒ፡ ቀላይ፡ በታሕቱ፡ ወተሠጥመ፡ ርአስየ።
verses.translation: Water was poured around me to the soul: the lowest deep compassed me, my head went down

translations.lxx: Water was poured around me to the soul: the lowest deep compassed me, my head went down
translations.kjv: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
translations.ron: Apele m-au învăluit pe de-a întregul, adâncul m-a împresurat, iarba mării s-a încolăcit în jurul capului meu;
translations.grk: Περιεχύθη μοι ὕδωρ ἕως ψυχῆς, ἄβυσσος ἐκύκλωσέ με ἐσχάτη, ἔδυ ἡ κεφαλή μου εἰς σχισμὰς ὀρέων,

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ንቅዓታተ፡ ደብር፡ ዋዋራድ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ዕጽው፡ መናስግቲሃ፡ እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ ትዕርግ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሙስና፡ ኀቤከ፡ እግዚኦ፡ አምላኪየ።
verses.translation: to the clefts of the mountains; I went down into the earth, whose bars are the everlasting barriers: yet, O Lord my God, let my ruined life be restored.

translations.lxx: to the clefts of the mountains; I went down into the earth, whose bars are the everlasting barriers: yet, O Lord my God, let my ruined life be restored.
translations.kjv: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
translations.ron: Mă coborâsem până la temeliile munţilor, zăvoarele pământului erau trase asupra mea pentru totdeauna, dar Tu ai scos din stricăciune viaţa mea, Doamne Dumnezeul meu!
translations.grk: κατέβην εἰς γῆν, ἧς οἱ μοχλοὶ αὐτῆς κάτοχοι αἰώνιοι· καὶ ἀναβήτω φθορὰ ζωῆς μου Κύριε ὁ Θεός μου.

verses.geez: ሶበ፡ ኀልቀት፡ ነፍስየ፡ ትዝክርክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ትብጻሕ፡ ጸሎትየ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ጽርሐ፡ መቅደስከ።
verses.translation: When my soul was failing me, I remembered the Lord; and may my prayer come to thee into thy holy temple.

translations.lxx: When my soul was failing me, I remembered the Lord; and may my prayer come to thee into thy holy temple.
translations.kjv: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
translations.ron: Când se sfârşea în mine duhul meu, de Domnul mi-am adus aminte, şi la Tine a ajuns rugăciunea mea, în templul Tău cel sfânt!
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ τὴν ψυχήν μου, τοῦ Κυρίου ἐμνήσθην, καὶ ἔλθοι πρὸς σὲ ἡ προσευχή μου εἰς ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου.

verses.geez: እለሰ፡ ዐቀቡ፡ ከንቶ፡ ወሐሰተ፡ ገደፋ፡ ሣህሎሙ።
verses.translation: They that observe vanities and lies have forsaken their own mercy.

translations.lxx: They that observe vanities and lies have forsaken their own mercy.
translations.kjv: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
translations.ron: Cei ce slujesc idolilor deşerţi dispreţuiesc harul Tău;
translations.grk: Φυλασσόμενοι μάταια καὶ ψευδῆ, ἔλεος αὐτῶν ἐγκατέλιπον.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ ምስለ፡ ቃለ፡ ስብሐት፡ ወተጋኝ፡ እሠውዕ፡ ለከ፡ መጠነ፡ ጸለይኩ፡ በሕይወትየ፡ አዐስዮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: But I will sacrifice to thee with the voice of praise and thanksgiving: all that I have vowed I will pay to thee, the Lord of my salvation.

translations.lxx: But I will sacrifice to thee with the voice of praise and thanksgiving: all that I have vowed I will pay to thee, the Lord of my salvation.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
translations.ron: Dar eu Îţi voi aduce Ţie jertfe cu glas de laudă şi toate făgăduinţele mele le voi împlini, căci mântuirea vine de la Domnul!"
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ μετὰ φωνῆς αἰνέσεως καὶ ἐξομολογήσεως θύσω σοι, ὅσα ηὐξάμην ἀποδώσω σοι σωτηρίου τῷ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez: ወአዘዞ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለውእቱ፡ ዓንበሪ፡ ወአውፅኦ፡ ሌናስ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And the whale was commanded by the Lord, and it cast up Jonas on the dry land.

translations.lxx: And the whale was commanded by the Lord, and it cast up Jonas on the dry land.
translations.ron: Şi Domnul a dat poruncă peştelui şi peştele a aruncat pe Iona la ţărm!
translations.grk: Καὶ προσετάγη ἀπὸ Κυρίου τῷ κήτει, καὶ ἐξέβαλε τὸν Ἰωνᾶν ἐπὶ τὴν ξηράν.
